paragraphs.en: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
paragraphs.cn: 金黄的林中分出两条路，

paragraphs.en: And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood
And looked down one as far as I could
To where it bent in the undergrowth;
Then took the other, as just as fair,
paragraphs.cn: 于是我选择了另一条，同样美丽，

paragraphs.en: And having perhaps the better claim,
Because it was grassy and wanted wear;
paragraphs.cn: 因为它芳草萋萋，少有人迹；

paragraphs.en: Though as for that the passing there
Had worn them really about the same,
I shall be telling this with a sigh
paragraphs.cn: 多年后我将叹息着诉说，

paragraphs.en: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I—
I took the one less traveled by,
paragraphs.cn: 我选择了人迹更少的那一条，

paragraphs.en: And that has made all the difference.
paragraphs.cn: 从此决定了我一生的道路。
